description: Get US economic data from 816K+ FRED series — GDP, CPI, unemployment, interest rates, money supply (Federal Reserve)

limit.description: Maximum number of observations to return (default 100000).

observation_end.description: End date for observations in YYYY-MM-DD format.

observation_start.description: Start date for observations in YYYY-MM-DD format.

series_id.description: FRED series ID (e.g. "GDP", "CPIAUCSL", "UNRATE", "DFF", "T10Y2Y"). Browse at fred.stlouisfed.org.

sort_order.description: Sort order by observation date. Default "asc".

name: finance.macro.indicator

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Economic Indicator
